source_metadata.title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional–Encoding–Free State–Space–Attention Language Models
source_metadata.author: Róisín Luo

extraction_limitations: The source is a technical report/reference implementation rather than a conventional controlled empirical study.

No held-out language-model benchmark comparison, perplexity comparison, positional-encoding baseline ablation, or long-context extrapolation result is reported; therefore no such performance atoms were created.
Novelty statements such as “first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding” are preserved as author claims and were not independently verified.
Figure-derived numeric atoms use values explicitly stated in captions or surrounding text; curves were not digitized beyond those reported values.
Pure bibliography pages (approximately pages 10-14 after the conclusion) were not atomized.
No formal funding, conflict-of-interest, or dedicated data-availability section was identified in the PDF; the repository link was captured as code availability only.
